Operation: Break Out of This Slump!
“Keke is all out of ideas…” After hearing Keke say that, Liella! heads out to Harajuku in search of fresh inspiration.
Our Town: A Photo Report
One day, μ's decides to make a report video—answering fans' wish to learn more about the girls and the town they live in. Camera in hand, the group sets off all over town…!?
Numazu's Wonderful—Come See for Yourself!
One day, Aqours gets a request to put on a live to promote the local shopping street. Happy to accept, they head out and tour the various shops, but they just can't pull their ideas together…!?
Draw, Connect, Network
According to Kasumi, the next live will be held out in nature! The club members are surprised, but ideas soon start flowing. Meanwhile, Rina—who usually relies on digital devices—looks troubled…!?
The Seagull's Troublesome Delivery

With the heat making outdoor practice unbearable, Liella! decides to hold a training camp at the beach! Since they're there anyway, a heated game of beach volleyball breaks out—but then a seagull does the unthinkable…!?
Whose Hands Will Hold the Flag of Victory?
Umi is packing her summer break full of club activities and studying! Worried she won't really get to enjoy it, Honoka and Kotori team up with the others to hatch a plan…!?
Descending on the Silver Moonlit Hill

Yoshiko and Ruby were stuck on making their costumes. Seeing this, Mari decides to gather ideas from the group. When the two still don't seem satisfied, Mari declares, “We're going to the mountains!”…!?
What Will Pop Out!? Halloween

With the Halloween live over and nothing fun left to look forward to, Lanzhu is restless. Taking up Mia's suggestion to throw a Halloween party, they decide to surprise the other members. Shizuku and Yu, who overhear the plan, join in too…!?
Heart-Pounding School Info Session!

Ren gathers everyone for an important talk. With hearts racing, the members learn that the crucial school info session season is about to begin—and the four second-years are chosen as its committee…!?
Christmas Parties Are Always the Best!
Seeing Akihabara filled with Christmas spirit, Honoka proposes a Christmas party for μ's. As everyone looks back on the year at the party, Eri declares, “Our work this year isn't over yet”…!?
Happy New Year from Awashima!

Chika eagerly counts the days left in the year, looking forward to the New Year. When Aqours says they have no plans for the holidays, Mari makes a proposal: “A countdown and New Year's party at Hotel Ohara!”
Who Will Get the Chocolate!?

When Lanzhu learns that Valentine's Day in Japan is about giving chocolate to that “special someone,” she throws a curveball at the Nijigasaki club's plan to make and share chocolates together. “Aren't you giving any to your ‘special someone’? What about you, Yu?”
A White Day of Hearts Connecting
As White Day draws near, Sumire and Ren spot Mei fretting over what to give the third-years in return. The two start thinking about how they might support Mei without making it obvious…

One day, Setsuna receives an invitation to the Love Song Carnival. Even after studying romance through novels and anime, she can't quite connect it to her own feelings. What advice will Shizuku give her!?

My Love Song: Shioriko

One day, Shioriko receives an invitation to the Love Song Carnival. When she asks Kasumi what kind of romance might suit her, she gets an unexpected answer. “I'm not going to micromanage a relationship like that!”
My Love Song: Mia
One day, Mia receives an invitation to the Love Song Carnival. Having written all kinds of love songs before, she figured she'd knock it out in no time… or so she thought?
